projects.title: Static
projects.description: A radio operator alone on a night shift picks up a voice that shouldn't exist. Shot over four nights in a decommissioned broadcast station in Queens.

images.caption: Night shift — frame from the final cut

projects.title: The Pillowman
projects.description: Martin McDonagh's pitch-black fable staged in the round, with the audience close enough to feel implicated. Four actors, one bare bulb, no interval.

projects.title: Proof
projects.description: David Auburn's chamber piece about inheritance — of genius, and of doubt. Played on a single porch set that slowly lost its walls as the play went on.

projects.title: Orbiting
projects.description: A ten-minute two-hander about a couple deciding whether to move apart, told entirely while circling each other. Festival audience award.
